description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot configuration class for the Eclipse Hono project's AMQP protocol adapter. It includes bean definitions for adapter properties, adapter instances, connection event producers, and meter registry customization, as well as configuration methods for client factory configurations.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the AMQP protocol adapter, defining beans and configuration methods.

methods.name: vertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter instance.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides configuration for downstream sender factory with default name if unset.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides configuration for registration client factory with default name if unset.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides configuration for credentials client factory with default name if unset.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides configuration for tenant client factory with default name if config is not null.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for the AMQP adapter as a Spring bean.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Provides a factory bean for creating AMQP adapter instances.

methods.name: connectionEventProducer
methods.description: Provides a connection event producer, defaulting to LoggingConnectionEventProducer.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Customizes the meter registry with common tags for metrics.
